name: Altdorf Occupying Forces
description: The military and political force sent by Emperor Karl-Franz to seize Ubersreik from the Jungfreuds. They control the city's defenses and tax collection but are viewed as interlopers by many locals.

name: Ubersreik Town Council
description: The local governing body, formerly ceremonial, now wielding genuine power in the absence of a Duke. They are pushing for Ubersreik to become a 'Freiburg' (free city).

name: House Jungfreud
description: The former ruling family of Ubersreik, recently deposed by the Emperor. Though exiled to Neufaljung, they retain many loyalists within the city and control the surrounding Duchy of Black Rock.
hq: Neufaljung Castle (Exiled) / Formerly Black Rock Castle

name: The Town Watch
description: The local law enforcement. Much of the old guard was dismissed for Jungfreud loyalty; the new Watch is a mix of Altdorf soldiers and new recruits, struggling to maintain order.

name: Merchants' Guild
description: The political powerhouse of the city, currently leading the push for Freiburg status. They control trade and influence the Town Council heavily.

name: Lowhaven Clan
description: A powerful Halfling crime family running rackets, smuggling, and loan sharking. They use Satrioli's Sausage Shop as a front.

name: The Baron's Gang
description: A rising criminal organization based in the shanty town under the bridge. They are ruthlessly expanding and opposing the Lowhavens.

name: House Bruner
description: A fabulously wealthy noble house enriched by mining. They are long-time rivals of the Jungfreuds and are using the occupation to increase their power.

name: House Aschaffenberg
description: A prominent noble family. The Duke has retreated to his lands, but his wife remains in the city trying to maintain their status.

name: House Karstadt (Karstadt-Stampf)
description: The richest merchant family in Ubersreik, formerly noble. They control banking and trade, with deep ties to Altdorf capital.

name: Metalworkers' Guild
description: Controls the smithing and metal trade. They have close ties to the Dwarf community but are currently threatened by the Cutlers.

name: Worshipful Guild of Cutlers
description: A rising guild exploiting loopholes to sell weaponry. Secretly guided by an Elven smith.

name: Boatmen's Guild
description: Represents the river workers. They maintain neutrality in politics but are heavily involved in river smuggling.

name: Guild of Boatbuilders and Chandlers
description: A small but powerful guild vital to the local economy. Its leader is secretly involved in a Chaos cult.

name: Dockers' Guild
description: Controls the loading and unloading of cargo. They hold a monopoly on the wharves.

name: Wahlund's Rat Catchers
description: A newly reorganized guild led by foreigners, aggressively hunting rats and secret enemies in the sewers.

name: Cult of Sigmar
description: The dominant religious order, currently supporting the Altdorf occupation and calling for unity.

name: The Crosses (Cult of Ranald)
description: A semi-open secret society of gamblers and thieves who run a soup kitchen and fencing operation.

name: Dwarfs of Dawihafen
description: The insular Dwarf community of Ubersreik. They generally stay out of human politics but maintain the city's walls and bridges.

name: The Fractured Eye
description: A clandestine Tzeentchian spy network and cult seeking knowledge and influence.

name: The Shifting Grasp
description: A Tzeentch cult of smugglers and riverfolk who believe mutation and change will bring prosperity.

name: The Yellowbellies
description: Skaven slaves and human thralls serving the Skaven Under-Empire, often acting as spies.
